# 什么是 llms.txt？

- 原标题：What Is llms.txt?
- 作者：Flavio Amiel Roborank 创始人
- 原文更新日期：2026-07-14
- 原文：https://roborank.io/glossary/llms-txt/
- 栏目：[AI Search & GEO](https://roborank.io/ai-search/)
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。原文中的数据、观点、平台说明及推广内容均按原文保留，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

llms.txt 是一种处于提议阶段的纯文本文件，放在网站根目录，为大语言模型提供经过筛选、以 Markdown 编排的网站重要内容地图。它是一份邀请清单，告诉模型为了理解网站应该读什么，而不是一套访问规则；这也正是它与 robots.txt 的区别。

### 核心要点

- llms.txt 由 [Answer.AI](http://Answer.AI) 的 Jeremy Howard 于 2024 年 9 月提出，旨在作为一种让语言模型更容易使用网站内容的标准。
- 它位于根目录，例如 [example.com/llms.txt](http://example.com/llms.txt)，使用 Markdown 编写，包含关键页面的链接及简短说明。
- 它是邀请，而非指令：robots.txt 控制爬虫是否可以访问页面，llms.txt 则建议模型应该优先阅读哪些内容。
- 是否采用完全自愿。截至 2026 年初，没有主要 AI 服务商公开确认将它用于排名或检索信号。

### llms.txt 如何运作

llms.txt 刻意保持简单。你在域名根目录放置一份 Markdown 文件，开头是 H1 网站名称、一段简短的引用式概述，接着是按 H2 标题分组的链接列表，例如“文档”“API 参考”“指南”；每个链接后用一句话说明页面涵盖什么。支持这一约定的模型或 [AI 爬虫](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-crawler/)可以先读取该文件，将其当作目录，直接跳转到权威页面，而不是根据站点地图猜测，或抓取整个网站。

还可以选择提供配套的 llms-full.txt 文件，将这些关键页面的全文直接整合在一份文档中，让模型通过一次请求就能摄取全部相关语料。这种格式的设计目的，是清楚地放入上下文窗口：没有导航界面、广告或模板化杂项，只有内容及其结构。

### llms.txt 与 robots.txt：最容易混淆的区别

这两种文件的位置和命名模式相近，恰恰因此容易混淆。[robots.txt](https://roborank.io/glossary/robots-txt/) 是指令：它告诉爬虫哪些路径允许抓取、哪些不允许，遵守规范的爬虫会照做。llms.txt 是建议：它告诉模型哪些内容值得阅读，却不授予任何权限，也不阻止任何访问。你完全可能发布一份 llms.txt，指向 robots.txt 明令禁止抓取的页面；两份文件在技术上都有效，却相互矛盾。访问控制仍由 robots.txt 决定，llms.txt 始终只是提出建议。

### llms.txt 示例

想了解好的 llms.txt 长什么样，最直接的方法是阅读那些业务高度依赖开发者理解文档的公司所发布的文件。Anthropic、Stripe 和 Cloudflare 都提供了 llms.txt，它们的做法很有启发性。Anthropic 用一份精简的 llms.txt——约 8,400 个 token，作为精选索引——搭配一份约 481,000 个 token 的 llms-full.txt，后者整合了完整 API 文档，让模型可以一次获取。Cloudflare 按产品组织文件，使助手只需提取所询问服务的相关上下文；其完整版达到数百万个 token。

Stripe 的做法最能说明问题。除了罗列文档，它还增加了一个别人没有的部分：面向 LLM 代理、明确说明如何正确集成 Stripe 的操作指示。这体现了这种格式的真正意图，不是“给我排名”，而是“请这样准确地介绍和使用我的产品”。公司把该文件视为面向机器读者的文档，并通过内容设计防止模型把集成方式弄错。

在发布端，这种格式普及得很快：根据 BuiltWith 的追踪，截至 2025 年 10 月，已有超过 **844,000 个网站**放置了 llms.txt 文件。但在使用端，需要诚实面对现状：没有主要 AI 服务商确认会把该文件作为检索或排名信号来读取；2025 年的相关报道还指出，AI 平台自身对这一格式的采用已经停滞。发布它，相当于押注一种尚未得到主流模型认可的约定。

这些例子传递的经验是一致的。这三家公司推出 llms.txt，并不是为了获得排名，而是希望 AI 助手回答开发者有关其 API 的问题时，使用当前的权威来源，而非一篇过时的博客文章。它的收益是答案准确性，不是曝光量；这属于文档维护工作，值得为此去做，却不应被夸大成增长工具。

### 人们常犯的错误

几乎每周都有人让我“为了 AI SEO 加上 llms.txt”，而我通常会劝团队不要把它视为增长工具。没有主要模型确认它会改变检索内容，所以仅仅上线一个文件，就期待获得更多引用，是一种盲目模仿。它真正有价值的地方，是文档密集的网站——开发者工具、API 和知识库——因为一份清晰的权威文档 Markdown 索引，能让助手更容易正确回答产品问题，而不是产生幻觉。创建它，应当是为了让自己的文档更适合机器理解，而不是以为找到了进入 ChatGPT 引用列表的后门。它带来的好处是准确性，而非排名。

### llms.txt 与 Robots.txt 对比

|  | llms.txt | robots.txt |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **用途** | 建议阅读什么 | 控制允许访问什么 |
| **类型** | 邀请 | 指令 |
| **格式** | Markdown | 纯文本规则 |
| **提出／标准化时间** | 2024 年 9 月 | 1994 年 |
| **是否执行约束？** | 否 | 由遵守规范的爬虫执行 |

位置相同，职责却相反。完整的并排比较见 [llms.txt 与 robots.txt 对比页面](https://roborank.io/ai-search/llms-txt-vs-robots-txt/)。如果只记住一件事：robots.txt 决定访问权限，llms.txt 决定注意力应放在哪里。

### 常见问题

#### llms.txt 有什么用途？

llms.txt 用清晰的 Markdown 为语言模型提供经过筛选的网站关键内容地图，让 AI 助手无需抓取所有页面就能找到并阅读重要内容。它旨在提高模型理解和呈现网站信息的准确性，对文档密集型网站尤其如此。

#### llms.txt 和 robots.txt 是一回事吗？

不是。robots.txt 是沿用已久的标准，告诉爬虫哪些 URL 可以或不可以访问。llms.txt 是较新的提议，建议模型优先阅读哪些内容。一个限制访问，另一个建议关注重点；两者解决的是相反的问题。

#### llms.txt 会提高 AI 搜索排名吗？

目前没有得到证实的证据。截至 2026 年初，没有主要 AI 服务商表示 llms.txt 会影响检索或引用。它的实际价值，是让模型更容易准确解析文档，而不是提高 AI 答案中的可见性。

#### llms.txt 文件应该放在哪里？

放在域名根目录，例如 [example.com/llms.txt](http://example.com/llms.txt)，位置约定与 robots.txt 相同。它是一份纯文本 Markdown 文件，列出最重要的页面及简短说明；还可以配上扩展版 llms-full.txt，包含这些页面的完整内容。

### 要点总结

llms.txt 是一种自愿采用的 Markdown 索引，向语言模型提供一份精选内容清单，并用一句话说明每个页面为何重要。它不是访问控制文件；根据现有证据，也不是排名信号。应把它视为让文档适合机器读取、能够被准确引用的方式——一种基础维护改进，而不是获取曝光的捷径。

## 英文原文

llms.txt is a proposed plain-text file, placed at a website’s root, that gives large language models a curated, Markdown-formatted map of the site’s most important content. It is an invitation listing what a model should read to understand the site, not a set of access rules — which distinguishes it from robots.txt.

### Key Takeaways

- llms.txt was proposed by Jeremy Howard of [Answer.AI](http://Answer.AI) in September 2024 as a standard for making site content easy for language models to consume.
- It lives at the root — [example.com/llms.txt](http://example.com/llms.txt) — and is written in Markdown, with links to key pages and short descriptions.
- It is an invitation, not a directive: robots.txt controls whether a crawler may access a page, while llms.txt suggests what a model should prioritize reading.
- Adoption is voluntary and, as of early 2026, no major AI provider has publicly confirmed using it as a ranking or retrieval signal.

### How llms.txt Works

llms.txt is deliberately simple. You place a Markdown file at your domain root that opens with an H1 site name, a short blockquote summary, and then a set of link lists grouped under H2 headings — “Docs,” “API reference,” “Guides” — each link followed by a one-line description of what the page covers. A model or an [AI crawler](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-crawler/) that supports the convention can read this file first and use it as a table of contents, jumping straight to the canonical pages instead of guessing from a sitemap or crawling the whole site.

An optional companion file, llms-full.txt, inlines the full text of those key pages into one document, so a model can ingest the entire relevant corpus in a single fetch. The format is designed to fit inside a context window cleanly — no navigation chrome, no ads, no boilerplate, just the content and its structure.

### llms.txt vs robots.txt — the distinction that trips people up

The two files share a location and a naming pattern, which is exactly why they get confused. [robots.txt](https://roborank.io/glossary/robots-txt/) is a directive: it tells a crawler which paths it is and is not allowed to fetch, and well-behaved crawlers obey it. llms.txt is a recommendation: it tells a model which content is worth reading, but grants no permissions and blocks nothing. You could publish an llms.txt pointing at pages your robots.txt disallows, and both would be technically valid and mutually contradictory. Access control stays with robots.txt; llms.txt only ever suggests.

### Example of llms.txt

The best way to see what a good llms.txt looks like is to read the ones shipped by companies whose entire business depends on developers understanding their docs. Anthropic, Stripe, and Cloudflare all publish them, and their choices are instructive. Anthropic pairs a compact llms.txt (about 8,400 tokens — a curated index) with an llms-full.txt of roughly 481,000 tokens that inlines its entire API documentation for a model to ingest in one fetch. Cloudflare organizes its file by product so an assistant can pull only the context for the service in question; its full version runs into the millions of tokens.

Stripe’s is the most telling. Beyond listing its docs, Stripe added a section no one else had: explicit instructions for LLM agents on how to integrate Stripe correctly. That is the real intent of the format on display — not “rank me,” but “here is how to represent my product accurately.” The company treats the file as documentation aimed at a machine reader, and shapes it to prevent the model from getting the integration wrong.

Adoption at the publishing end has been fast: by BuiltWith’s tracking, over **844,000 websites** had an llms.txt file as of October 2025. The consumption end is where the honesty is required — no major AI provider has confirmed that it reads the file as a retrieval or ranking signal, and reporting through 2025 noted that adoption among the AI platforms themselves has stalled. Publishing one is a bet on a convention the big models have not yet endorsed.

The lesson these examples teach is consistent. The three companies did not ship llms.txt to rank; they shipped it so that an AI assistant answering a developer’s question about their API pulls from the current, canonical source instead of a stale blog post. The payoff is answer accuracy, not visibility — a documentation-hygiene move, worth doing for that reason and not oversold as a growth lever.

### The thing people get wrong

I get asked to "add llms.txt for the AI SEO" almost weekly, and I usually talk teams out of treating it as a growth lever. No major model has confirmed it changes what they retrieve, so shipping one and expecting more citations is cargo-culting. Where it genuinely earns its place is documentation-heavy sites — dev tools, APIs, knowledge bases — where a clean Markdown index of your canonical docs makes it far easier for an assistant to answer questions about your product correctly instead of hallucinating. Build it because it makes your own docs machine-legible, not because you think it’s a back door into ChatGPT’s citations. The upside is accuracy, not ranking.

### llms.txt vs Robots.txt

|  | llms.txt | robots.txt |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Purpose** | Suggests what to read | Controls what may be accessed |
| **Type** | Invitation | Directive |
| **Format** | Markdown | Plain-text rules |
| **Proposed / standardized** | September 2024 | 1994 |
| **Enforced?** | No | By compliant crawlers |

Same address, opposite jobs — the full side-by-side is on the [llms.txt vs robots.txt page](https://roborank.io/ai-search/llms-txt-vs-robots-txt/). If you remember one thing: robots.txt decides access, llms.txt decides attention.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is llms.txt used for?

llms.txt gives language models a curated map of a site’s key content in clean Markdown, so an AI assistant can find and read the important pages without crawling everything. It is meant to improve how accurately models understand and represent a site, especially documentation-heavy ones.

#### Is llms.txt the same as robots.txt?

No. robots.txt is a long-standing standard that tells crawlers which URLs they may or may not access. llms.txt is a newer proposal that suggests which content a model should prioritize reading. One restricts access; the other recommends attention. They solve opposite problems.

#### Does llms.txt improve AI search rankings?

There is no confirmed evidence that it does. As of early 2026, no major AI provider has stated that llms.txt influences retrieval or citation. Its practical benefit is making your documentation easier for models to parse accurately, not boosting visibility in AI answers.

#### Where do you put the llms.txt file?

At the root of your domain, at [example.com/llms.txt](http://example.com/llms.txt), the same location convention as robots.txt. It is a plain-text Markdown file listing your most important pages with short descriptions, optionally with an expanded llms-full.txt containing the full content.

### The Bottom Line

llms.txt is a voluntary Markdown index that hands language models a shortlist of your best content and a sentence on why each page matters. It is not an access-control file and, on current evidence, not a ranking signal. Treat it as a way to make your documentation machine-legible and accurately quotable — a hygiene improvement, not a visibility hack.
